test_gate: Same6561testfaces. Strict accuracy/macroF1 gains over current58.3448%/.555367. No reduction in current macroP/R or disgustP/R/F1 (retain37/79disgust correct). method: Conditional TRAIN-feature manifold mixup within the native pure FusDense classifier. No external encoder. Same current pure TRAIN reference, balanced correct positive/negative disgust-boundary retention, discarded for inference. Mixed TRAIN features only; real unmodified validation/test images. Not a new backbone feature-learning result.
limits: Validation and test are historically reused; exploratory engineering, not fresh identity-disjoint confirmation. Full/head epochs not equivalent. No80%or reliable webcam/clinical guarantee.

run_condition: Only if prior experiment evaluated no new test and produced no eligible validation candidate; at most one tested candidate across both experiments.
